# `mise daemons providers`

- **Usage:** `mise daemons providers [SUBCOMMAND]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/daemons/providers.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/daemons/providers.rs)

[experimental] Manage shared servers from global `[daemon_providers]`

A shared server is one PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, or NATS server declared in your global config, with a separate database or account for each checkout that uses it. Not supported on Windows. See <https://mise.jdx.dev/daemons/sharing.html#shared-server-providers>

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List shared servers

```
mise daemons providers ls
```

Start the shared server named local-postgres

```
mise daemons providers start local-postgres
```
